claim: Zas Tours traditional-boat day cruise leaves Agia Anna pier 09:30 and returns ~17:30, stopping at Alyko, Rina Cave and Schinoussa or Iraklia, from EUR 93.60, 8 hours, stops swapped by weather.
quote: Agia Anna pier at 09:30 ... Approximately 17:30 ... Rina Cave ... Schinoussa or Iraklia ... From EUR 93.60 ... the order and selection of stops may change depending on the weather and sea conditions.

claim: Naxos-Paros has over 10 daily crossings in high season with Blue Star, Seajets, Fast Ferries and Golden Star, 20 min to 3.5 hr, from EUR 5.70.
quote: over 10 daily ferry crossings during the high season ... Starting from EUR 5.70 per adult ... 20 min to 3.5 hr

claim: Naxos-Koufonisia is served year-round by Blue Star, Small Cyclades Lines, Seajets and Hellenic Seaways; 35 min to 2.5 hr; fares from EUR 7 up to EUR 53.
quote: Starting from EUR 7.00 ... 35 minutes to 2.5 hours ... Throughout the year, you can reach Koufonisia from Naxos by ferry

claim: First Naxos-Koufonisia departure is 11:30 and the last 16:35, with 4-5 daily crossings May-September and 1-2 off-season.
quote: first ferry departs from Naxos Port at 11:30 ... the last at 16:35 ... During high season (May-September), there are 4-5 daily crossings

claim: Meltemi reaches 7-8 Beaufort from mid-July through August; high-speed catamarans and small-island ferries cancel first, while the Skopelitis only cancels on a full sailing ban.
quote: From mid-July through August, northerly meltemi winds regularly reach 7-8 Beaufort ... The first ferries to be cancelled are the high speed catamaran and the small ferries to small islands ... The Skopelitis is only cancelled when there is a sailing ban for all ferries.

claim: Express Skopelitis departs Naxos at 14:00 or 14:30 and returns to Naxos at 12:05 (Jul 3-Sep 10) or 13:05 (Mar 1-Jul 2, Sep 11-Oct 31), six days a week.
quote: Outbound from Naxos: 14:00 or 14:30 (depending on day/season) ... Return to Naxos: 13:05 (Season 1) or 12:05 (Season 2) ... Season 1: March 1 - July 2 and September 11 - October 31

claim: Small Cyclades ferry fares from Naxos run EUR 5-12 each way and the Skopelitis is a small, choppy boat.
quote: Ferry costs are EUR 5-12 each way, though the boat is small and the ride can be choppy.

claim: The Navigator sailing yacht runs a Small Cyclades day cruise from Agia Anna port 10:00-19:30 on Tuesdays and Fridays at EUR 110 per person, visiting Iraklia, Kato and Ano Koufonisi and Schinoussa.
quote: Agia Anna port, 10:00 AM ... 19:30 ... Tuesdays and Fridays ... EUR 110 per person ... Iraklia, Kato Koufonisi, Ano Koufonisi, Schinoussa

claim: The MTM Tourism SeaBus Delos+Mykonos cruise leaves Naxos ~09:00 and returns late afternoon (~10 hours), giving ~3 hours on Delos and ~3 hours on Mykonos, from ~$87-89, with no guide and Delos entry (~EUR 12) not included; cancels in high winds.
quote: Departure: Approximately 9:00 AM from Naxos ... Delos: Approximately 3 hours ... Entry fee NOT included (approximately 12 euros, paid on-site) ... just a boat transfer ... Weather-dependent cancellations are possible due to high winds or rough seas.

claim: The Delos archaeological site opens 08:00-20:00 daily in summer; admission EUR 12 full / EUR 6 reduced, and the museum is closed for construction.
quote: 8:00 to 20:00 daily ... The admission fee is EUR 12 for full price or EUR 6 for discounted rates ... the museum is currently closed due to construction works.

claim: Naxos-Mykonos runs March to November with Seajets, Fast Ferries and Golden Star, up to 7 departures a day in peak summer, 35 min to 1.5 hr, from EUR 20 out / EUR 29 back.
quote: Crossing Duration: 35 minutes to 1.5 hours ... Up to 7 departures during summer peak season ... Starting from EUR 20 per adult ticket ... usually from March to November
